_meta.status: DRAFT, read-only inventory. Not wired to any code.
_meta.source_of_truth: src/lib/deviceDetection.ts generateHexagons() and generateHexagonsAsync(); order here is the code order after the category sort used by HexagonGrid.
_meta.artwork_note: No hexagon artwork file exists for any web scan hexagon. Each is drawn at runtime as an inline SVG (src/components/Hexagon.tsx) with an emoji character from HexagonData.icon. The only hexagon image files in the repo are 16 PNGs for the report email's 8 categories (public/email/hex/<category>-found|empty.png, 216 KB). "artwork" below records the emoji and states file: null.

status_model.FOUND: detector ran and returned a value about the person; the value is shown.
status_model.CLEAR: CHECKED AND CLEAR: detector ran successfully and positively found nothing. Only meaningful for status_kind "risk-check".
status_model.NOT_CHECKED: detector did not run, was blocked, timed out, is unsupported, produced a placeholder, the user never interacted, or the hexagon was never produced. Always shown, with what is needed.

_meta.example_values_note: All example values are made up (IPs use the 203.0.113.0/24 documentation range).

hexagons.label: Location
hexagons.detection: IP geolocation from our own Worker mpt-leads GET /whoami (Cloudflare request data), city + region.
hexagons.detection_in_browser: no: server lookup via /whoami, called from the browser (captureDeviceData)

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of
status_rule.not_checked: /whoami failed or returned no city: code then shows the placeholder "Location detected".

hexagons.note: Code cannot tell a real result from a failed lookup: on failure it still emits the string "Location detected" and the hexagon looks FOUND. Must be changed to carry an explicit status.

hexagons.label: Device Type
hexagons.detection: navigator.userAgent parsed by detectDeviceType() and detectOS().

status_rule.found: always, from the user agent string.
status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of
status_rule.not_checked: only if the user agent is empty (OS shows "Unknown").

hexagons.label: Browser
hexagons.detection: navigator.userAgent parsed by detectBrowser(): name + major version.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of
status_rule.not_checked: only if the user agent is not recognised.

hexagons.label: Internet Provider
hexagons.detection: "org" field from Worker /whoami, first two words.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.note: On failure the code sets "Unknown ISP" and the hexagon shows "Unknown": the value cannot be told apart from a result without a status flag.

hexagons.label: Time Pattern
hexagons.detection: new Date().toLocaleTimeString() at the moment the hexagons are generated; recomputed on every regeneration.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.note: Value changes on every regeneration, so the email would show the time of the last render, not of the scan. Capture once.

hexagons.label: Screen Resolution
hexagons.detection: screen.width x screen.height.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.label: Privacy Settings
hexagons.detection: navigator.doNotTrack === "1".

status_rule.found: DNT disabled (tracking not signalled): show the value.
status_rule.clear: DNT enabled: report as CLEAR with the note that many sites ignore it.
status_rule.not_checked: never (property always readable, may be null on some browsers: null counts as "disabled" today).

hexagons.note: navigator.doNotTrack === null (unsupported) is reported as "DNT Disabled", which is indistinguishable from the user having chosen it. Treat null as NOT CHECKED.

hexagons.label: Connection Type
hexagons.detection: navigator.connection.effectiveType / type via getConnectionDisplay().

status_rule.found: effectiveType is "4g", "3g" or "2g", or type is "wifi".
status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.note: The fallback returns "WiFi" as a default assumption when the API is missing (deviceDetection.ts, getConnectionDisplay). That is a guess shown as a value. Treat as NOT CHECKED.

hexagons.label: How You Found Us
hexagons.detection: document.referrer matched against google / facebook / twitter / x.com / linkedin; empty = "Direct Visit".

status_rule.found: referrer matched or is an external link.
status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of
status_rule.not_checked: empty referrer cannot be told apart from a stripped one; show "Direct Visit" as FOUND only with that wording.

hexagons.note: Empty referrer = direct visit OR referrer stripped by privacy settings.

hexagons.label: Device Status
hexagons.detection: navigator.getBattery() level and charging.
hexagons.presence_condition: only added when navigator.getBattery() works (getBatteryInfo returns non-null): Chromium, mostly desktop/Android. Absent on Safari and Firefox.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of
status_rule.not_checked: hexagon is not generated at all when the API is missing: registry must still list it as NOT CHECKED.

hexagons.note: Absence is silent. The web scan has no "not checked" hexagon for it.

hexagons.label: Primary Language
hexagons.detection: navigator.languages[0] mapped through getLanguageName().

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.label: Language Fallbacks
hexagons.detection: navigator.languages[1..2].
hexagons.presence_condition: only when navigator.languages has more than one entry.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of
status_rule.not_checked: one language only: nothing to show (this is effectively CLEAR, but the code simply omits the hexagon).

hexagons.note: Omitted when absent, so the web scan cannot say "checked, only one language".

hexagons.label: Locale Mismatch
hexagons.detection: language list compared with the timezone.
hexagons.presence_condition: only when analyzeLanguageSettings() finds a language/timezone mismatch.

status_rule.clear: detector ran, no mismatch.

hexagons.note: The code only emits the hexagon when a mismatch exists, so CLEAR is invisible today. The registry can treat omission as CLEAR because the detector always runs (verified: runs inside captureDeviceData).

hexagons.label: Estimated Profile
hexagons.detection: estimateDemographic(): a fixed rule of thumb using the hour of day, OS and browser. Not a measurement.

status_rule.found: never as a fact. Confidence is hard-coded at 60.
status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of
status_rule.not_checked: recommended: always label as "estimate" or drop from the email.

hexagons.note: It is invented from the clock (the expression `os.includes("android") && hour >= 22 || hour <= 6` has an operator-precedence slip, so any OS can return "Young Adult" before 07:00). Showing an age band to a person in an email as a finding is risky.

hexagons.label: User Profile
hexagons.detection: determineUserProfile(): local | expatriate | traveler | multilingual from languages and mismatch.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.note: Inferred label with fixed confidence (70 to 85). Present as "our inference".

hexagons.label: Orientation
hexagons.detection: screen.orientation / window.matchMedia portrait check.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.label: Rotation
hexagons.detection: screen.orientation.angle.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.label: Tilt Forward/Back
hexagons.detection: DeviceOrientationEvent beta. Needs a motion sensor and, on iOS, permission.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of
status_rule.not_checked: value "N/A" and confidence 0: no sensor or no permission.

hexagons.note: Code does encode "N/A", but only in the value string.

hexagons.label: Tilt Left/Right
hexagons.detection: DeviceOrientationEvent gamma.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.note: Same as tilt-beta.

hexagons.label: Motion Sensors
hexagons.detection: detectSensors().gyroscope.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of
status_rule.not_checked: "Inactive" means not detected, not proven absent.

hexagons.note: "Inactive" is both "no sensor" and "no permission".

hexagons.label: Canvas Fingerprint
hexagons.detection: draws to an off-screen canvas and hashes the pixels (src/lib/fingerprintDetection.ts).
hexagons.value_type: text: first 8 hex chars of a hash + "..."

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of
status_rule.not_checked: detector threw or canvas blocked: hexagon omitted.

hexagons.note: Omission = blocked or failed; a blocked canvas is itself a protection signal, which the code cannot distinguish.

hexagons.label: WebGL Signature
hexagons.detection: WebGL renderer/vendor string.
hexagons.value_type: text: GPU name, cut to 12 chars + "..."

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.note: Same as canvas.

hexagons.label: Audio Signature
hexagons.detection: OfflineAudioContext render hashed.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.note: Same as canvas.

hexagons.label: Installed Fonts
hexagons.detection: measures text width for a list of fonts.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of
status_rule.not_checked: count 0 (detector failed or fonts blocked): omitted.

hexagons.note: Count 0 can be real or a failure; the failure default in the code is also count 0.

hexagons.label: Extensions
hexagons.detection: detectPlugins(): navigator.plugins count and ad-blocker bait test. Failure falls back to a default object, so the hexagon always appears.

status_rule.found: ad blocker or plugins detected: show value.
status_rule.clear: "None detected" with the detector having run.
status_rule.not_checked: cannot be told from "None detected" because the failure fallback is the same object.

hexagons.note: YES. Failure default { pluginCount:0, adBlocker:false } renders "None detected", i.e. a failed check shows as CLEAR.

hexagons.label: Fingerprint Protection
hexagons.detection: looks for Tor, Brave shields, Firefox resistFingerprinting, blocking extensions.

status_rule.clear: n/a in the usual sense; "None Detected" is a finding that the user is unprotected, treat as FOUND (exposed).

hexagons.note: "None Detected" is the default also when detection partly fails.

hexagons.label: WebRTC Leak
hexagons.detection: RTCPeerConnection with Google STUN servers, 3 second timeout, reads ICE candidate IPs (fingerprintDetection.ts).

status_rule.found: a public IP is exposed: value would contain an IP address. Do not put the raw IP in the email (see risks).
status_rule.clear: candidates gathered and none public.

hexagons.note: YES. When WebRTC is blocked, or the 3 s timeout fires, there are no candidates and the code returns "No Leak Detected". A blocked or failed test shows as CLEAR.

hexagons.label: CPU Cores
hexagons.detection: navigator.hardwareConcurrency and navigator.deviceMemory.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of
status_rule.not_checked: memory missing on Firefox/Safari (value shows cores only).

hexagons.label: Display Profile
hexagons.detection: screen size and devicePixelRatio.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.note: Overlaps the "screen" hexagon (same resolution).

hexagons.label: Timezone/Locale
hexagons.detection: Intl.DateTimeFormat timezone + navigator.language.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.note: Overlaps primary-language and the DeviceData timezone.

hexagons.label: Battery Status
hexagons.detection: navigator.getBattery().

status_rule.clear: API blocked/unavailable is reported as "Not Available"; this is a protection signal rather than a clear result.

hexagons.note: "Not Available" means unsupported browser OR blocked; both identical. Overlaps the "battery" hexagon.

hexagons.label: Connected Devices
hexagons.detection: navigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices() counts (no labels without permission).

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.note: "No Devices" is both "none exist" and "access blocked".

hexagons.label: Cookies
hexagons.detection: document.cookie of the site origin, counts, "tracking" if a name matches a known list (src/lib/storageDetection.ts).

status_rule.clear: "Empty" or "Disabled".

hexagons.note: Only sees cookies for myprivacytool.io itself; it says nothing about the rest of the web. Wording must say "on this site".

hexagons.label: Local Storage
hexagons.detection: localStorage keys of the site origin (our own 3 keys filtered out).

status_rule.clear: "Empty".

hexagons.note: Site origin only.

hexagons.label: Session Storage
hexagons.detection: sessionStorage items of the site origin.

status_rule.clear: "Empty".

hexagons.note: Site origin only.

hexagons.label: IndexedDB
hexagons.detection: indexedDB.databases() for the site origin.

status_rule.clear: "Not Used".
status_rule.not_checked: "Blocked", or the hexagon omitted on failure.

hexagons.note: indexedDB.databases() is missing in some browsers.

hexagons.label: Cache & SW
hexagons.detection: caches.keys() and service worker registrations for the site origin.

status_rule.clear: "Not Active".

hexagons.note: Site origin only.

hexagons.label: Google Account
hexagons.detection: Google auth cookie names (SID, HSID, NID ...) read from document.cookie by src/lib/socialDetection.ts (cookie NAMES only).

status_rule.found: cookie names present in document.cookie: show count.
status_rule.clear: NOT SUPPORTED by the method (see ambiguity).

hexagons.note: YES, and serious. A page on myprivacytool.io can only read cookies set for myprivacytool.io. It cannot see google.com, facebook.com, microsoft.com or other sites' cookies (same-origin rule; browsers enforce it). So "Not Detected" / "No Platforms" / "Not Linked" will be shown to nearly everyone whether or not they are logged in. This is NOT CHECKED in truth, not CLEAR. Not verified in a live browser; based on how document.cookie works and on the code reading document.cookie only (socialDetection.ts, getCookiePresence).

hexagons.label: DNS Leak
hexagons.detection: detectDNSLeak(): despite the name, it runs the same WebRTC probe as webrtc-leak (STUN) and a user-agent check for DoH support. No DNS query is made (securityDetection.ts).

status_rule.found: "Leaking (...)": would show part of a public IP.
status_rule.clear: "No Leak Detected" only if WebRTC returned candidates and none were public.
status_rule.not_checked: initial placeholder "Checking..." (the value is overwritten asynchronously, after the hexagon list is first returned); "Check Failed" on error; also when WebRTC is blocked.

hexagons.note: YES. Value starts as "Checking..." and is mutated in place later, so whatever is read at report time depends on timing. A blocked WebRTC gives "No Leak Detected". The label overstates what is measured (it is a WebRTC heuristic, not a DNS test).

hexagons.label: Connection Security
hexagons.detection: window.location.protocol and isSecureContext. hstsEnabled is assumed from secure context, not read from a header.

status_rule.clear: HTTPS.

hexagons.note: "+ HSTS" is inferred, not measured.

hexagons.label: Mixed Content
hexagons.detection: DOM query for http: resources on OUR page.

status_rule.clear: "None".

hexagons.note: Describes our site, not the user. It will be CLEAR for everybody. Low value for a personal report.

hexagons.label: Security Headers
hexagons.detection: Inferred from browser features (document.referrer, isSecureContext, "permissions" in navigator). Response headers are not read (code comment: "inferred").

status_rule.clear: strong score.
status_rule.not_checked: would be the honest status: headers are not actually read.

hexagons.note: Not a real header check; reports a guess. Describes our site, not the user.

hexagons.label: Browser Status
hexagons.detection: user agent major version compared with a hard-coded minimum (VULNERABLE_VERSIONS in securityDetection.ts).

status_rule.clear: version at or above the minimum.

hexagons.note: Hard-coded thresholds go stale; unknown browsers show "Outdated" (should be NOT CHECKED).

hexagons.label: Encryption
hexagons.detection: protocol check plus a user agent guess: "TLS 1.3 (likely)" for Chrome 70+ / Firefox 63+, else "TLS 1.2 (minimum)". The negotiated TLS version is not readable from a page.

status_rule.clear: HTTPS.
status_rule.not_checked: the exact version is never measured.

hexagons.note: Guess presented as value.

hexagons.label: Mouse Tracking
hexagons.detection: mousemove listener on our page (src/lib/behaviorDetection.ts), started when HexagonGrid mounts.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.note: Value depends on when it is read; zero = not interacted yet, not "clear".

hexagons.label: Keystroke Dynamics
hexagons.detection: keydown timing on our page (only counts and timing, no key content).

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of
status_rule.not_checked: "No input yet": the user has not typed. Most users never type during the scan.

hexagons.note: Zero is not clear; it means not observed.

hexagons.label: Click Patterns
hexagons.detection: click listener on our page.

status_rule.found: clicks recorded (always above 0 by the time the user finishes).
status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.label: Scroll Behavior
hexagons.detection: scroll depth on our page.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.label: Session Duration
hexagons.detection: seconds since startSessionTimer() on page load.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of

hexagons.note: Changes every second until captured; capture at request time.

hexagons.label: Engagement Map
hexagons.detection: click/mouse hotspots on our page.

status_rule.clear: n/a: an informational hexagon, there is nothing to be clear of
